title: Implementation
description: Build stacks and queues with arrays, linked lists, and each other.
identify: The task asks for stack or queue operations with strict ordering
The data structure must be implemented without using its standard library equivalent
explanation: Choose the representation that gives each required operation its target complexity.

title: Prefix, Infix and Postfix Conversions
description: Convert and evaluate expressions while respecting precedence and associativity.
identify: Operators and operands must preserve evaluation order
Parentheses and precedence affect the output
explanation: Use an operand stack and an operator stack, or scan from the direction that makes the target notation natural.

title: Monotonic Stack
description: Use ordered stacks to answer nearest-element and contribution queries in linear time.
identify: The answer depends on the next or previous greater or smaller element
Elements can be discarded once they can no longer affect a future answer
explanation: Each element enters and leaves the stack once, turning many quadratic scans into linear passes.
